hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook for the Quiver platform on Robinhood Chain that skims a per-pool tax (0–10%) on every swap via afterSwap using the return-delta mechanism, accruing fees in WETH or the launched token. Harvested fees are split 50/25/25 among token holders (converted to a configured stock reward), the pool creator (claimable WETH), and a protocol treasury.
